blockingIssues.description: Realtime WebSocket upgrade handling is not initialized in api/server/index.js even though wsPath '/api/realtime/ws' is exposed, so realtime route smoke can pass while realtime sessions fail. Wire initializeRealtimeServer(server) after app.listen and add startup coverage for ws handling.

deleteUserMcpServers ownership filtering in api/server/controllers/UserController.js treats any ACL entry as ownership and any other ACL principal as another owner, which breaks sole-owner semantics and can retain orphaned servers or delete wrongly. Restrict owner checks to USER principals with DELETE permission.
